qualification.details: Candidates must possess, by the last date of application, either: | B.Sc Nursing (4-year course) from an Indian Nursing Council/State Medical Faculty recognised Institute or University, or B.Sc Nursing (Post Basic) (2-year course) from an Indian Nursing Council recognised institute/university, and be registered as Nurse & Midwife in State/Indian Nursing Council; OR Diploma in General Nursing Midwifery (GNM) from an Indian Nursing Council recognised Institute/Board/Council, registered as Nurse & Midwife in State/Indian Nursing Council, with two years' experience in a minimum 50-bedded hospital after acquiring the above qualification. | Only permanent residents (Domicile) of Uttar Pradesh are eligible to apply for reserved posts (both horizontal and vertical reservation); SC/ST/OBC/EWS/DFF/Women/Ex-servicemen candidates who are not original residents of UP will be considered Unreserved (UR). selection_process: Selection is through a Computer Based Test (CBT) of objective-type questions related to nursing

with 80% questions on theoretical knowledge and 20% on practical knowledge. No candidate is allowed to enter the examination without an admit card issued by the designated examination body. Negative marking applies: 0.25 mark is deducted for each wrong answer; unanswered questions carry no penalty. Candidates with equal marks are ranked by age
with the older candidate placed higher in the merit list. Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General

and OBC candidates; 35% for SC and ST candidates. The "Mark for Review" option is available during the CBT within the active section's time only; a question answered and marked for review is evaluated as the final answer
while one left unanswered and marked for review is treated as unattempted. Final selection is based on: (i) Merit in the CBT
and (iii) Medical Examination. Selected candidates must undergo the required medical examination as per prescribed rules.

how_to_apply: The application process is divided into five parts:
Filling up of details of the form
Uploading photo, signature, and other documents
Payment of fees and application form submission

Only the Online Application System is applicable; applications sent through any other medium will not be accepted. Candidates should read the advertisement carefully to confirm they meet the qualification and age criteria before starting the form, and refer to the User Instruction document available on the website. Candidates can amend their application before final submission, except for their registered mobile number, email ID, Aadhaar number, and category, and only once after final submission.
important_instructions: Only the date of birth recorded in the High School or equivalent certificate will be valid. Reserved category candidates must mention their category in the application; only UP domicile candidates get the benefit of reservation. Ex-servicemen and dependents of freedom fighters must submit their claim in the prescribed format issued by the competent authority. Applicants in regular Government service must present a "No Objection Certificate (NOC)" from their employer. No printed/hard copy of the online application or documents needs to be sent by post; however, applicants must keep a printed copy with them. Hall tickets can be downloaded from gims.ac.in and will not be sent by post. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the written test or Document Verification. All disputes/lawsuits fall under the jurisdiction of Gautam Buddha Nagar only. Cheating, indiscipline, misbehaviour, or undesirable conduct in the exam hall will lead to cancellation of candidature and may result in debarment from this and future examinations. The Institute grants only provisional admission to the CBT; candidature can be cancelled at any later stage, even after a decision for appointment, if found ineligible. The Director, GIMS Greater Noida, reserves the right to fill or not fill any or all advertised posts without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: GIMS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The last date for fee submission and the CBT exam schedule will be published separately on the institute's website as per the examination schedule; candidates should check gims.ac.in regularly, as no individual correspondence will be made by the Institute.

content_sections.heading: GIMS Staff Nurse Vacancy 2026 - Category-Wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 100 Staff Nurse vacancies have been notified, with vertical (category-wise) reservation as follows. Horizontal reservation will additionally apply within these vacancies, as per Uttar Pradesh Government norms. The number of unreserved and reserved vacancies may increase or decrease as per Uttar Pradesh Government reservation acts, ordinances, and orders.

content_sections.heading: GIMS Staff Nurse Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess, by the last date of application, either: B.Sc Nursing (4-year course) from an Indian Nursing Council/State Medical Faculty recognised Institute or University, or B.Sc Nursing (Post Basic) (2-year course) from an Indian Nursing Council recognised institute/university, and be registered as Nurse & Midwife in State/Indian Nursing Council; OR Diploma in General Nursing Midwifery (GNM) from an Indian Nursing Council recognised Institute/Board/Council, registered as Nurse & Midwife in State/Indian Nursing Council, with two years' experience in a minimum 50-bedded hospital after acquiring the above qualification. Only permanent residents (Domicile) of Uttar Pradesh are eligible to apply for reserved posts (both horizontal and vertical reservation); SC/ST/OBC/EWS/DFF/Women/Ex-servicemen candidates who are not original residents of UP will be considered Unreserved (UR). Male candidates who are married and have more than one living wife, or female candidates who have married a man with an already-living wife, are not eligible unless exempted by the Governor.

content_sections.heading: GIMS Staff Nurse Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age will be reckoned as on 1 July 2026. Candidates must have attained 21 years of age and must not be more than 40 years old. Persons dismissed by the Union Government or any State Government are not eligible for appointment to any post. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: GIMS Staff Nurse Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates belonging to other (horizontal reservation) categories must pay the fee according to their basic vertical category. The fee is non-refundable, and the application printout cannot be taken until the fee is deposited.

content_sections.heading: GIMS Staff Nurse Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a Computer Based Test (CBT) of objective-type questions related to nursing, with 80% questions on theoretical knowledge and 20% on practical knowledge. No candidate is allowed to enter the examination without an admit card issued by the designated examination body. Negative marking applies: 0.25 mark is deducted for each wrong answer; unanswered questions carry no penalty. Candidates with equal marks are ranked by age, with the older candidate placed higher in the merit list. Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General, EWS, and OBC candidates; 35% for SC and ST candidates. The "Mark for Review" option is available during the CBT within the active section's time only; a question answered and marked for review is evaluated as the final answer, while one left unanswered and marked for review is treated as unattempted. Final selection is based on: (i) Merit in the CBT, (ii) Biometric and document verification, and (iii) Medical Examination. Selected candidates must undergo the required medical examination as per prescribed rules.

faq.question: Q1. What is GIMS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by the Government Institute of Medical Sciences, Greater Noida, to fill 100 Staff Nurse posts through a Computer Based Test (CBT) Examination 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GIMS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 100 vacancies are notified, with UR-40, OBC-27, SC-21, ST-2, and EWS-10.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GIMS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 7 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for GIMS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: B.Sc Nursing (4-year or Post Basic 2-year) with registration as Nurse & Midwife, or a GNM diploma with registration plus two years' experience in a minimum 50-bedded hospital.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GIMS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be 21 to 40 years old as on 1 July 2026, with relaxation available for SC/ST/OBC, PwD, and Ex-servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GIMS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹1,298 (inclusive of GST) for UR/OBC/EWS candidates, ₹944 for SC/ST candidates, and exempted for Divyang candidates with UP domicile.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for GIMS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted online only at www.gims.ac.in between 10 August 2026 and 7 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GIMS Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on merit in the CBT, followed by biometric and document verification, and a medical examination.
